free_resources.title: Se vale sentir: el arte de reconciliarte con tus emociones
free_resources.description: A free teaching from Casa Tíbet México on relating to difficult emotions such as anxiety, anger and sadness without suppressing or over-analysing them. It explains the Buddhist view of afflictive mental states and links a recorded introductory session in which instructor Daniela Labra teaches staying with the bodily feel of an emotion.

left_out: 'La práctica de nuestros botones: cómo manejar la ira': no page of its own on the site (not in its sitemaps); a video only, and videos are handled separately.
flags: Se vale sentir is a Spanish-language post (31 Jul 2026) in the centre's free teachings; it ends by inviting readers to the August 2026 seminar (passed), but the teaching itself is evergreen.
